sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Kabila wins historic election
geopolitical_news.summary: Joseph Kabila defeats Jean-Pierre Bemba in October's runoff, the first democratic vote in 40 years.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bemba rejects result
geopolitical_news.summary: The runner-up alleges fraud as Kinshasa sees sporadic clashes.

sport.headline: DR Congo miss 2008 AFCON
sport.summary: The Leopards fail to qualify for the Ghana tournament.

sport.headline: DR Congo compete at Beijing Olympics
sport.summary: Congolese athletes take part in the 2008 Games.

sport.summary: The Leopards fall short in qualifying for Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.summary: Kabila maneuvers to stay beyond his 2016 term limit.
